{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Count completed orders in the cleaned data
completed_count = df_clean['status'].value_counts()['completed']

# Final check: ensure no other issues
print(f"Completed orders (after removing QA and cleaning revenue): {completed_count}")"}
